occurrences.excerpt: Benchmarking MLLMs on Video. With MLLMs displaying impressive performance on still-images across perception, reasoning, and multi-disciplinary tasks [39, 52, 98, 99], there is increasing interest in evaluating MLLMs’ video understanding capabilities [23, 24, 43, 44, 47, 51, 54, 55, 63, 85, 96].
